fields.title: 8. Three data points to check yourself before the next issue
fields.md:
1. **Executed 8-K (Item 1.01·2.03)**: the master lease's fixed rate · whether the principal rose from about $40 billion to about $44 billion · call and guarantee terms · whether there are usage restriction clauses such as 'chips stay on the ground' (source: `state.triggers_next_12m[T5]`).
2. **T7 ⓕ answer (11/30)**: whether SpaceX publicly answered the 3 questions from the Senate Foreign Relations Committee (source: `state.triggers_next_12m[T7]`).
3. **Existing checkpoints**: Ariane 64 LE-04 (11/23, T4) · DA 26-1160 reconsideration deadline (11/27, T8) · monthly 12/01 · T2 12/8 lock-up · T12 12/9 vote (source: `state.triggers_next_12m`).
